Education for children without Thai nationality and children of migrant workers
se: Meeting on Wednesday 18 November 2026 at 10.30, committee meeting room CA 426, Floor 4, Parliament House, and online. The agenda is the draft report on education for children without Thai nationality and children of migrant workers, a case study of non-governmental organisations' work in Samut Sakhon and Tak, by the learning promotion subcommittee, and the work of the subcommittees. The summary will be added after the Senate publishes it.
it: Draft report on education for children without Thai nationality and children of migrant workers (Samut Sakhon, Tak)

Expanding dual vocational education: information from the Labour Ministry and the EEC
se: The education and vocational education subcommittee reported progress on policy proposals to expand and raise dual vocational education, with information from the Ministry of Labour, such as the labour market situation and the “Thai Mee Ngan Tham” jobs database, and from the Eastern Economic Corridor Office (EEC) on cooperation between businesses and vocational colleges and manpower needs in the area.
it: Policy proposals to expand and raise dual vocational education (Ministry of Labour, EEC)

Proposals to raise Thai universities in international rankings
se: A working group of the higher education subcommittee presented its draft report on raising Thai universities in international rankings, such as a special law and fund to push selected high-potential fields linked to the country's target industries, learning from foreign institutions that turn research into real products with private investment, and changing academic promotion criteria to give more weight to research that is actually used. The education and vocational education subcommittee then reported on its work.
it: Draft report on raising Thai universities in international rankings
